message.content:
**How to kill Visual Studio Code (code.exe) from the command line**

On Windows you can terminate the VS Code process (or all its instances) with the built‑in `taskkill` utility.

---

### 1️⃣ Kill *all* running VS Code windows

```cmd
taskkill /IM code.exe /F
```

* `/IM code.exe` – matches the image name (`code.exe`).  
* `/F`          – forces termination (equivalent to “End Process” in Task Manager).

This will close every instance of VS Code that is currently running.

---

### 2️⃣ Kill a **specific** VS Code window

If you only want to close one particular instance, first get its Process ID (PID):

```cmd
tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq code.exe"
```

Look for the row that contains your target window and note the PID number.

Then run:

```cmd
taskkill /PID <PID_NUMBER> /F
```

Replace `<PID_NUMBER>` with the actual numeric PID you found.

---

### 3️⃣ Optional: Wait for graceful shutdown before forcing

If you prefer to give VS Code a chance to shut down cleanly, omit `/F`:

```cmd
taskkill /IM code.exe
```

It will wait until the process exits normally; if it hangs, add `/F` to force it.

---

### 4️⃣ Running from PowerShell

In PowerShell you can also use the same command, but you may need to escape the slash:

```powershell
Start-Process -FilePath "taskkill.exe" -ArgumentList "/IM", "code.exe", "/F" -NoNewWindow -Wait
```

Or simply call the CMD command directly:

```powershell
cmd /c "taskkill /IM code.exe /F"
```

---

### 5️⃣ Common pitfalls

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| “Access denied” error | Run the command prompt as Administrator. |
| No matching process found | Make sure VS Code is actually running; check the exact image name (`code.exe` vs `Code.exe`). |
| Multiple instances still open | Some background services (e.g., extensions) may spawn child processes; use `/T` to terminate the entire tree: `taskkill /IM code.exe /F /T`. |

---

#### TL;DR

```cmd
:: Kill all VS Code windows
taskkill /IM code.exe /F

:: Or kill a specific instance
taskkill /PID <PID_NUMBER> /F
```

That’s all there is to it!
